newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Arab Emirates plans to increase its investments on Iran's Qeshm island.
- Yemen spends 41 billion riyals annually on Qat.
- Saudi Prince al-Waleed bin Talal set up a new real estate investment firm with $48 million paid-in capital.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines denies fare reduction to Beirut.
- France's Giat Industries is to invest in a shipping firm in the UAE. Total of France agreed to set up a plant to produce paint for oil pipes in the United Arab Emirates.
